reuse.why: Selects categories through the shared MONTH_ACTION_CATEGORIES_QUERY that every month-wide action uses, reads the existing sum-amount sheet cell, and registers the handler with the same mutator(undoable(...)) wrapper.

duplication.why: Repeats the tree's per-action loop skeleton (income/tracking skip, sign flip for expenses) as the sibling actions do, but adds no new copied logic beyond that convention.

placement.why: The action sits in budget/actions.ts next to the other month-wide actions and is exposed in budget/app.ts beside them.

scope.why: Only the new action, its handler registration, tests and a release note.

maintainability.why: Short and in the same shape as its siblings, and the category rule stays in the one shared query, so changes there apply automatically.
